title: Wot Shiro Bites with Nutty Crunch
description: A keto breakfast recipe featuring wot, shiro, and nutty crunch. Perfect for a quick morning bite.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together.
Add the shiro and wot to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Roll the dough into small balls and place them on a baking sheet.
Sprinkle the nutty on top of the balls.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the edges are lightly browned.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
